n32b521f1af.headline: Today's Economy - How Far Will Lebanon Sink into the Crisis?
n32b521f1af.summary: Lebanon has been enduring its worst recession in history for over a year, with the currency losing 90% of its value.
n32b521f1af.why: Lebanon's severe economic crisis impacts regional stability, investor confidence, and financial markets linked to the country.
n32b521f1af.why_moved: The currency collapse reflects the deep recession, affecting Lebanon's economy and investor risk perception.
